sections.content: Meta tags in <head> describe your page to search engines: <title>, <meta name="description">, Open Graph tags for social shares, canonical URLs, and robots directives.
One H1, descriptive titles, fast pages, and semantic content all rank better. Structured data (JSON-LD) enables rich results like FAQ boxes.
Key points: title ~50-60 chars, description ~150-160, every page needs unique meta, and sitemap.xml helps crawlers discover pages.

sections.codeExample:
<head>
    <title>Learn HTML - Guide</title>
    <meta name="description" content="A beginner guide to HTML.">
    <link rel="canonical" href="https://site.com/page">
</head>
